title: Quarterly lattice: align Hosted API feature cadence with model-catalog rotation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: produce a repeatable quarterly plan that sequences Hosted API product features (billing QoS, streaming TLS enhancements, structured outputs) with model-catalog rotations and gating (canary windows, eval gates, fallback models). The output is a sliceable roadmap and playbook for PM/Eng/Design that minimizes customer regression risk while enabling faster model updates.
acceptance_criteria: A single quarter roadmap artifact (CSV + timeline) that maps feature releases to model catalog rotations and canaries
Defined canary windows with rollback criteria and threshold metrics (latency, token-cost delta, top-k quality metrics)
Runbook for cross-functional cutover (Console flags, API deprecations, client SDK compatibility notes)
OKR-linked metrics and owner assignments for each initiative entry
Signoff from Eng, Reliability, Design, and Legal for any customer-impacting catalog changes
tasks: Interview owners from Serving Runtime, Console, and Model Onboarding teams to capture constraints (owner: Daniel Kim)
Collect model health telemetry and recent eval regressions for candidate catalog rotations (owner: Research)
Draft timeline aligning feature dates with model canaries; surface conflicts (owner: Asha Patel)
Define gating metrics and rollback thresholds; validate against historical incidents (owner: SRE lead)
Create a console-visible rollout flag plan and SDK compatibility matrix (owner: Developer Experience)
Write customer communication templates for deprecations or model behavior changes (owner: Growth/Comms)
Schedule cross-functional review workshop and record decisions in Confluence (owner: PM)
Publish final roadmap artifact and attach to release train and OKR tracker (owner: PM)
Plan post-release monitoring dashboard with alert thresholds and evaluation prompt sets (owner: Observability)
Retrospective checklist to capture lessons and tune next quarter's lattice (owner: PM)
comments: 2026-02-18: Asha Patel - Ticket created. Initial hypothesis: model-catalog rotations are often scheduled independently and cause last-minute engineering churn. Goal is to formalize a lattice that ties model changes to feature windows.
2026-02-22: Daniel Kim - Gathered constraints from runtime team. Key constraint: cannot run full-model canaries on peak-week traffic due to tokenization variance. Proposing staggered canary windows.
2026-02-28: Sofia Martinez (Design) - UX note: Console needs an explicit "Model Rotation" timeline view so customers can correlate model changes with incidents; added to tasks.
2026-03-03: Eng (ENG-49211 owner) - Identified dependency: KV-cache compatibility test matrix must be completed before any quantized model rotation. Blocking until 2026-03-20.
2026-03-07: Reliability - Suggested gating metrics: 99th p90 latency delta <= +30ms, token-cost delta <= +3%, user-facing hallucination rate not increasing by >5% on eval prompts.

2026-03-09: Legal/Compliance - No extra review required for routine catalog rotations; however private/on-prem customers with locked model lists require separate opt-in flows. Flagging for communication templates.
2026-03-10: Asha Patel - Draft timeline attached to Confluence (link below). Preparing workshop invite for 2026-03-16.
